translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Fioangon Awewe Erhai Rhooan Aeperes Faiun Foat
Iwe noan rhag raaenin we Jesus a siusaengi iimw we a noa reen meoneoiniun we, iwe a noa mooat tiw wenepeigin.
Nge aeremas towunap kkewe ra itto reen, iwe a teeotae wooan efoarh pwoot a ittae mooat wooan. Nge rhooawe ra iu nee ppiy.
Jesus a fioang awewe ngaeniir towunepaen aegiaeg, iwe a aengaeniir pwe, “Erhai mwaaen a noa pwe epwe noa aeperes faiun foat.
Igiwe e aeperes fetaen foat kkewe, nge aekkaefai ra ppiungiutiw wenepeigin aan we, nge man aeniaen ra itto anginoa.
Aekkaefai ra ppiungiutiw wooan kaenefai, igiwe ese maniueon ppweon ee. Faiun kkewe ra mwetekkaein pwaechetae, pwe igiwe rese no ppweon ttonoa.
Nge igiwe aenet a ttinitae, nge a aeppwesa noa foat kkewe; pwe igiwe waeran foat kkewe ese nennoan noa, iwe a mwetekkaein mae noa.
Aekkaefai ra ppiungiutiw neeiin irae towfanfan. Iwe irae towfanfan kkewe ra menawtae nge ra fittitae wooar iwe ra maenoa.
Nge aekkaefai ra ppiungiutiw noan ppweon mwamwaai, iwe ra uuwa: aekkaefai ra uwaeni epwiugiuw, aekkaefai woneig, nge aekkaefai eniig.”
Iwe Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Iyo eyor saeningan, epwe rongorong!”
Faaen Aaen Jesus Kkepesaen Fioangon Awewe
Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra itto reen Jesus nge ra aeiineow pwe, “Meeta wo kkepas noan fioangon awewe iga wo kkepas ngaeniir reen?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Deus a fang ngaenigaemi pwe oawpwe giuneei kkepas mwoanomwoanon minna Mweoiu Naaeng, nge ikka aaemweoi ese ngaenneer.
Pwe iyo a yor meeta aan nge repwe pwan fang ngaeni iwe epwene igin ssow noa aan, nge iyo ese yor meeta aan nge repwe pwigi saengi mwo nge iwe egius iwe eyor reen.
Faaen aaei kkepas ngaeniir noan fioangon awewe, pwe iga re pipiiy noa nge rese weri, nge repwe aiussaening nge rese rongorong, nge rese pwan metaf reen.
Iwe a pwae pwe ennet minikkiwe mwaeniaen profeta Isaiah:

content.text: ‘Oawpwe aiussaening me aiussaening nge oawsoapw metaf;
oawpwe pipiiy me pipiiy nge oawsoapw weri.
Pwe aar niunniuwaen rhooakkeei nge a pwurh,
nge ra pineyinoa saeningeer, nge ra ammaiur noa meseer.
Ngaere ese ieei wusuur, ina nge meseer epwe weriwer

content: Ieei minne mwaeniaen Deus.
“Nge aaemi oawwa wenepwu! Pwe mesaemi ra weriwer nge saeningaemi ra rongorong.

Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe towunap profeta me aeremas mwamwaai ra mwerhaen weri meeta kka aaemi oawwa weri, nge iir rese weri. Ra pwan mwerhaen rongorong meeta kka aaemi oawwa rongorong, nge iir rese rongorong.
Jesus e Aemmetefa Fioangon Awewen Rhooan Foat we
“Iwe oaw aiussaening, pwe oawpwe metaf reen fioangon awewen rhooan foat we.

Rhooa kkewe re rongorong kkepesaen Mweoiu Naaeng, nge rese metefaaegini, ra taeppen rhag faiun foat kkewe re ppiungiutiw wenepeigin aan we. Iwe Man Aenneew we a itto pwigi saengiir minne a toonong nee tipeer.
Nge faiun kkewe re ppiungiutiw wooan kaenefai, ra aeffitaeg ngaeni rhooawe re aetiwa miniwe kkepesaen Deus noan kker reen rhag oaton we ra rongorong.
Nge kkepas we ese waaraar me nee tipeer, iwe ese ssiunaei wooar. Nge aere a yor fitigogo me waeiraes faaen itaen miniwe kkepesaen Deus, ra mwetekkaein fangetae.

Nge faiun kkewe re ppiungiutiw neeiin irae towfanfan, ra aeffitaeg ngaeniir rhooawe re rongorong kkepesaen Deus, nge aiunaeng reen menaw e igina me mwecheniaen pisaegin feoniufan ra oamoapwu miniwe kkepesaen Deus, pwe esoapw mmwenen uuwa.

Nge faiun kkewe re ppiungiutiw wooan ppweon mwamwaai, ra aeffitaeg ngaeniir rhooawe re rongorong miniwe kkepesaen Deus nge ra metaf reen: iwe, ra uuwa, aaemweoi ra uwaeni epwiugiuw, aaemweoi woneig, nge pwan aaemweoi eniig.”
Fioangon Awewen Fetin
Jesus a pwan fioangei ngaeniir pwan eew fioangon awewe: “Mweoiu Naaeng a aeffitaeg ngaeni minneen. Erhai mwaaen a aeperes faiun foat gacch noan aan menaai.
Noan eew pwongin, igiwe aeremas ra maiur, erhai man aenneew a itto aeperes pwuger mwaaen neeiin maat we, iwe, a noa.
Oatowe faiun foat kkewe ra menawtae nge ra uuwa, iwe nge a noa pwae noa pwuger mwaaen kkewe.
Mwaaen kkewe naiun rhooan engaang ra itto reen nge ra aengaeni pwe, ‘Menap, saapw faiun foat gacch miniwe wofoat noan menaai we oamw?. Nge iya rhag pwuger mwaaen ra noa itto me ee?’
A paniuwaeniir pwe, ‘Erhai man aenneew a feeori minneei.’ Iwe, rhooawe rhooan engaang ra aeiineow pwe, ‘Wo mwerhaen aeipwe noa wiytae pwuger mwaaen kenaan?’
Iwe a paniuwaeniir pwe, ‘Aapw, pwe aere oawpwe wiytae pwuger mwaaen kenaan nge emmwen pwe faiun foat kkewe repwe pwan wisaegtae.

Oaw nigitiir pwe repwe menaw ppagtae toori oaton ee sipwene gin. Iwe nge ngaang ipwe naaen aengaeni rhooan affeeoriun repwe mmwaen wiytae pwuger mwaaen kkewe, ra geoni fengaenniy nge ra figiir noa. Iwe ra ioni fengaenniy faiun foat kkewe nge ra iseniir nong noan aaei imwaen soko.’ ”
Fioangon Awewen Faiun Mustard
Iwe, Jesus a fioangei ngaeniir pwan eew fioangon awewe: “Mweoiu Naaeng a aeffitaeg ngaeni minneen. Erhai mwaaen a pwigi efai faiun mustard a noa foatogi noan aan menaai.

Iiy minne oarosaen mwittigin me neeiir faiun irae, nge igine a menawtae nge iiy minne oarosaen temoag me neeiin irae me noan menaai we. A ssiuwen ngaeni efoarh irae faeregit, pwe man aeniaen repwe itto ffeeor feseer wooan raaen.”
Fioangon Awewen Yeast

Iwe, Jesus a fioangei ngaeniir pwan eew fioangon awewe: “Mweoiu Naaeng a aeffitaeg ngaeni minneen. Erhai rhooapwut a pwigi egius yeast nge a nofiti fengaenniy me enuuw pwaecchin fenoawa emas toori aan pwo tae fenoawa we.”
Faaen Aaen Jesus Aeyae Fioangon Awewe
Jesus a aeyae fioangon awewe aan epwe aepesa ngaeniir pwuwaen aeremas oanongaen minikkeei; esoapw aepesa mwo nge epat aegiaeg ngaeniir igine ese aeyae fioangon awewe.
A feeori minneei pwe epwe pwaeritae pwe ennet miniwe profeta a aepesa pwe,

content.text: “Ngaang ipwe aeyae fioangon awewe iga ipwe kkepas ngaeniir.
Ngaang ipwe aepesa ngaeniir minikka rese giuneei saengi rhaepetaen feoniufan.”

content: Jesus a Aemmetefa Fioangon Awewen Fetin we

Iwe igiwe Jesus a noa saengi pwuwaen aeremas kkewe nge a toonong noan eew iimw, rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra itto reen nge ra aengaeni pwe, “Wopwe aemmetefa ngaenigemaem meeta faaen fioangon awewen fetin we noan menaai we.”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Mwaaen we aeperes faiun foat kkewe egacch nge ina iiy Naiun Aeremas;
menaai we ina feoniufan; faiun foat kkewe regacch ina aeremesaen Mweoiu Naaeng; nge pwuger mwaaen kkewe, ina iir naiun Man Aenneew we;
nge man aenneew we e foatogi pwuger mwaaen kkewe ina Saetan. Nge oaton gin nge ina nee soapwonoan feoniufan, nge rhooan affeeoriun gin we ina iir angkenus.
Wunuunun pwuger mwaaen kkewe ra ioni fengaenniy nge ra figiir tae wooan aengaet, nge ina wunuunun minne epwe wen nee soapwonoan feoniufan.
Miniwe Naiun Aeremas epwene fangenoa naiun angkenus pwe repwe ioniir iyo kkewe reno noan Mweoiun iwe re paeni ngaeniir monofit, pwan rhooawe refeeori wegitaeg aenneew,
nge repwe oatoranong noan nenien aengaet, iga repwe sessaeng nge akkaarengi me ee.
Iwe rhooa mwamwaai repwene ttin taeppen aenet noan Mweoiun Semeer. Iyo eyor saeningan, epwe rongorong!
Fioangon Awewen Pisaeg Kooap

“Mweoiu Naaeng a pwan weei minneen. Erhai mwaaen enoa rhuungi eew pisaeg kooap egin rhaeng me wooan eew maat. A pwaniuw sefaaen noa nge noan aan kker a noa ameow noa oanongaen minikkena pisaegin, nge a sefaaen noa nge a noa meoni maat we.
Fioangon Awewen Faiun Usowus
“Mweoiun Naaeng a pwan weei minneen. Erhai mwaaen rhooan chuwaai nge e kiukkiutta fetaen faiun usowus kka nning,
nge igine a giuneei efai min igin yor ipitan, a noa ameow noa oanongaen pisaegin nge a meoni faiun usowus we.
Fioangon Awewen Wuug
“Mweoiun Naaeng a pwan weei minneen. Aaemweoi rhooan fita ra aekkaerh wow aar wuug noan meoneoiniun we nge ra niyap mesemesaen iig.
Oatowe wuug we a sseog reen iig, nge ra iuriunong nee ppiy, mwirin ra mooat tiw pwe repwe aemegena fesaenngiy iig kkewe: iig gacch ra iseni nong noan rhiug, nge iig kkewe re aenneew ra oatoranoa.
Epwe ieei wunuunun nee soapwonoan feoniufan. Angkenus repwene noa aeyimweoiuw fesaenngiy aeremas aenneew saengiir aeremas mwamwaai.
Repwe oatoranong aeremas aenneew noan nenien aengaet, iya repwe sessaeng nge akkaarengi me ee.”
Minne Effeo me Maerhiy
Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Oaw metefaaegini oanongaen minikkaan?” Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Ooa.”

Iwe a aengaeniir pwe, “Ina nge faaen minneei ina oanongeer sinsein anniug kka repwe no pwe rhooan kkayeo noan Mweoiun Naaeng ra taeppen rhag soaw iimw we e oatowowuw pisaeg mini ffeo me min maerhiy me noan soko we aan.”
Rhooan Nazareth Rese Aetiwa Jesus
Igiwe Jesus a moann aan fioangei fioangon awewe kkewe, a noa saengi pwiuneoi we
nge a noa nee pwugusan. A fenai noan wutteer Jews we, nge rhooawe re rongorong ngaeni ra riutae reen. Ra aeiineo, “Iya woneei a pwigi me ee aan tipaecchem me kkeman kka aan?
Ifa wusun, soapw woneei miniwe naiun taikusang we? Saapw Maria miniwe inan? Me saapw James, Joseph, Simon me Judas nge pwiin?
Soapw oanongeer mwengeyan nge reno igeei? Iya woneei a pwigi oanongaen minikkeei me ee?”
Iwe resa aetiwa no iiy. Jesus a aengaeniir, “Erhai profeta eyor aesirowun me noan oanongaen pwiuneoi, nge ese yor aesirowun me noan sipegin taeninimwan aere noan imwan.”
Pwe iga esooar aar niugiuniug, ina minne Jesus ese feeori towunepaen kkeman kkewe aan me igiwe reen.
